memory_candidates.content: When a Lean plan's `## Lean Challenge Statements` signature collides with a repo lint gate (here: a snake_case `DerivationTree`-valued `def` tripping mathlib's `defsWithUnderscore` linter via `check-module-invariants.sh` C16), prefer a documented per-declaration `attribute [nolint ...]` over restating the theorem in a different type. Restating `⊢ᴮᴸ[fc] φ` (DerivationTree, data) as `BaseLanguage.Derivable fc [] φ` (Nonempty of that data) builds green and looks harmless, but it weakens the recorded Challenge statement from data to Prop — exactly the same-name-weaker-statement move that `plan-compliance.md`'s Statement Fidelity section exists to catch. The lint suppression is cosmetic and visible at the site; the signature change is neither.

In this Lean tree, BL's box over task frames is the UNIVERSAL modality over the whole model — history-blind by definition (BLTruthAt's box clause does not mention the history) and time-blind by Semantics.Truth.box_const. Machine-checked as FormalSystem.Semantics.bl_box_universal. Consequence, reusable well beyond any one task: BL over task frames is not a product logic in the hard sense, the box/H,G interaction contributes no same-time alignment validities, and the right Kripke target is an indexed family of duration-order chains with a universal box. That is what makes a valuation-only truth lemma over multiFamTaskFrameGen possible at all.
